taskHints.text.llm: Turns your prompt into a scene-by-scene script.
taskHints.vision.llm: Looks at a picture you drop in and writes the scene from it. Needs a vision model on your LLM server.
taskHints.image.gen: Draws the still frame each clip is animated from.
taskHints.video.i2v: Animates a keyframe into a moving clip.
taskHints.video.t2v: Renders a clip straight from the text, with no keyframe.
taskHints.transcribe: Times the captions against the narration.

deleteMessage: Removes {size} from disk. Jobs that need it will fail until it's downloaded again — the download is always available here.
discardMessage: Throws away the {size} downloaded so far. A later download starts from zero instead of resuming.
pauseMessage: Nothing is lost — the downloaded part stays on disk and Resume picks up exactly where it stopped.
